lina: quick heads-up — noticed a latency bump on canary for llama3-13b when rope_theta default moved from 10k->12k. short chat templates (<128 tokens) go from 80ms -> 140ms p50

james: hmm, did kernel selector pick a different matmul kernel or fall back to slowpath?

lina: looks like selector dropped to the generic fused-attn on some batches. profiler shows more memcpy and KV evict churn. snippet from perf: 
```
perf report: kernel=fused_attn_generic, memcpy=12%->31%, kv-evict=30ops/s->120ops/s
```

max: is this correlated with head_dim/hidden_size mismatch? we changed head packing for siLU/RMSNorm updates last week.

lina: i checked model meta — hidden_size and heads unchanged. but chat template injection changed input distribution: more short prompts with system + few user turns, so runtime sees many tiny queries which disable one of our continuous-batching heuristics.

sophia: could be batching heuristic threshold. when batch_size < 4 we switch kernel to favor latency which apparently triggered slower path after rope_theta change?

james: rope_theta affects rotary cos/sin frequency; why would that change kernel selection?

lina: theory: increased rope_theta causes longer effective positional span for KV, so our KV cache footprint per request increases slightly -> pushes some requests over our in-RAM threshold, causing extra evictions and a different memory layout that the kernel-selector maps to generic path.

max: can you repro locally with a synthetic stream? try forcing same short template shape and run `runtime-ci profile --model llama3-13b --template short-chat --rope_theta 12000`

lina: did that. results attached in gist (link): https://tiny.redwood/prof/gist-2001 
Profile condensed: p50 85ms (rope=10k) -> 142ms (rope=12k), memcpy spikes, kernel selection flips to fused_attn_generic for sequences <64 in many cases.

sophia: okay, two axes to test: 1) restore rope_theta default for canary and see if perf returns, 2) tweak batching heuristic to not flip kernels if kv-evict rate < threshold.

james: we should be careful restoring rope_theta — that risks quality regressions. prefer mitigation in runtime: keep rope_theta as-is but add a kernel pin for llama3-13b that prefers fast matmul when heads/hiddens match canonical layout.

max: agree. add a heuristic: if avg_tokens_per_request < 128 and kv-evict_rate < 50ops/s, bias kernel selection toward fast_pack path. also log a metric we can alert on.

lina: implemented quick experiment in a branch: 
```
// pseudo
if (model.family=="llama3" && avg_tokens<128 && kv_evictions<50) prefer_kernel("fast_pack_attn");
```
I pushed to canary branch — requesting rollout to the 10% canary.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for runtime-canary llm-runtime:v3.4.1-ropefix at 2001002235

james: after patch, initial telemetry shows p50 back to ~88ms, memcpy down. need 24h stability then can consider making heuristic permanent.

sophia: also create an eval to check generation quality under rope_theta=12k vs 10k for our chat templates. we can't lose coherence improvements if any.

lina: will do eval and collect perf for 24h. if stable, promote heuristic and open a follow-up to revisit kernel-selector cost model to include KV footprint.

runtime-ci: perf job queued: `queue perf/llama3-13b/short-chat/ropeTheta` (id: 2001-rc1)

max: thanks — nice catch. filing a short postmortem if this impacts prod. add me on the follow-up PR. :thumbsup:

lina: will update thread with link to PR + eval results in ~24h.
